'''Sund Technologies''', also known as '''Sund Tech''', was a manufacturer that was allied with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The company was founded by [[Tarkos Sund]], a businessman and inventor.
